title: MAdES interoperability vectors, envelope 1
description: The shape shared by every file in vectors/. Until v1.8.1 these files declared a $schema that did not exist, on a product domain, and nothing in the data said how signingInput was encoded — two files answered that question differently and a second implementation had to guess. The envelope is deliberately loose about case shape, which differs per rule, and strict about the two things a consumer cannot infer: which specification version a file records, and how its bytes are encoded.

$schema.description: This schema. A vector file that points at a schema which does not resolve is worse than one that points at none: it looks described.

specVersion.description: The specification version this file records, for files that pin a document-level rule.

blockVersion.description: The block `version:` these cases carry. Independent of specVersion (§0.2).

signingInputEncoding.description: REQUIRED whenever any case carries `signingInput`. `base64` means the field holds base64 of the UTF-8 signing input and MUST be decoded before use; `utf8` means it holds the signing input itself. Both occur: these files are recordings, and a recording is not re-encoded to tidy it up.
